name: tree
behavior: APG TreeView pattern: role=tree containing role=treeitem rows and role=group child lists; roving tabindex (one item tabbable); ArrowDown/ArrowUp move, ArrowRight expands then enters, ArrowLeft collapses then exits to parent, Home/End jump to first/last visible, Enter/Space select, typeahead moves to the next matching label; aria-level, aria-expanded and aria-selected on every item

parts.statesNote: rotates 90deg when open at duration-fast; its space is reserved (invisible) on leaf items so labels align across depths

parts.note: nested role=group list; each depth indents by one space-inline-md step — indentation is rhythm (a spacing slot), never a raw value

anatomyNotes: Modeled on the APG TreeView with Salt's core tree as the intent source (single selection, per-node disable, typeahead, keyboard map). Salt's multiselect-with-checkboxes mode is a composition with the checkbox anatomy, not part of the base tree intent, and stays in the Salt adapter.
